messages:
Sam: Heads-up — saw /v1/completions p95 jump from ~120ms -> ~420ms around 2026-03-22 15:30 UTC after adaptive-routing rollout. Route-level p95 looks flat. Screenshot: https://redwood.example/dash/abc123 :thinking: Anyone seeing this?
Olivia: what's the sample_count on the endpoint? could be a sample-origin skew (client vs server timestamps).
Ben: routing change made today routes 15% to variant-b which has larger KV cache warmup. Also added a small burst queue for backpressure — could increase tail.
Kai: FYI our dashboard's endpoint pane uses client-side total_time, route pane uses server_processing_ms. If client time includes network batching that would explain difference.
Sam: query I used (console -> metrics -> "endpoint.latency.p95"): ```select p95(latency_ms) from traces where endpoint='/v1/completions' and env='prod' and ts >= '2026-03-22T15:00Z'``` export tdigests: td_count=4. Screenshot above.
Jess: can we get a few traces around 15:28? /debug/traces?start=2026-03-22T15:25Z&end=2026-03-22T15:35Z Show KV cache hit header X-KVCACHE-HIT.
deploy-bot: canary adaptive-routing v2 deployed by olivia at 2026-03-22T15:27:45Z
Olivia: will try ramping variant-b back to 0% for 10m to see effect.
Ben: command: ```/admin route-weight set completions variant-b 0.0 --duration=10m```
Kai: long-term UX: we should surface 'latency by sample-origin' toggle (client vs server vs proxy) + sample counts. Ticket: https://redwood.example/issue/ENG-13459
Sam: created ENG-13459 (dashboard: sample-origin toggle + sample_count overlay) and linked graph. Assigning to frontend.
Jess: quick note — p99 unchanged which suggests median shift in client measurement. Might be some client-side batcher change for a subset of calls.
Ben: I'll own dashboard query change + runbook note detailing what to check (t-digest counts, kv hit, route weights).
Olivia: thanks. I'll monitor after ramp. update in 10m. :thumbsup:
Sam: thx all. follow-up in Dashboard sync on Wed.
